items.t: Altria, AbbVie and Enterprise Products Partners Are Paying Investors More Heading Into 2027
items.sum: A tobacco giant, a pharma heavyweight and a midstream pipeline operator all hiked their payouts this year. Each faces a different threat to the income it promises, and one hides a tax headache that catches retirees off guard.

items.t: Enterprise Products Partners (EPD) Stock May Be Undervalued Despite Distribution Growth
items.sum: Enterprise Products Partners has rewarded long term unitholders with a strong 5 year run, which puts fresh attention on whether the current unit price lines up with what its earnings can support. With the stock now well above where it traded five years ago, investors are asking how much of its earnings power is already reflected in today’s valuation. Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 143.

items.t: A 72-Year-Old With $350,000 in Pfizer, Enterprise Products and EPR Properties Collects $1,785 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $350,000 portfolio split evenly across Pfizer, Enterprise Products Partners and EPR Properties pays about $21,400 a year, or about $1,790 a month, at today’s prices. Enterprise Products covered its distribution 1.

items.t: Can EPD's Balance Sheet Support Its Distribution Growth & Expansion?
items.sum: Enterprise' stable cash flows, conservative balance sheet and $6.3 billion project pipeline position it to balance infrastructure expansion with distribution growth.

items.t: Better Dividend Stock for Retirees: Philip Morris vs. Enterprise Products
items.sum: Key TakeawaysPhilip Morris International yields 3. 4% and Enterprise Products Partners yields 6.

items.t: An $850,000 Portfolio in Verizon, NNN REIT and Enterprise Products Pays $52,395 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $850,000 portfolio split evenly across Verizon, NNN REIT and Enterprise Products Partners pays about $4,370 a month in dividends at today’s prices. All three dividends look safe, and Enterprise’s is the best covered and the fastest growing.
